name: Linear Regression
description: Simple least-squares regression of one numeric column on exactly one numeric predictor, optionally per group. coefficients mode returns one row per term (intercept and slope) with std_error, t_statistic, p_value, r2 and n; predict mode keeps every input row and adds the prediction and residual columns.

x.title: Predictor
x.description: Numeric predictor columns; exactly one column is supported.

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: Optional grouping columns: one fit per group.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: coefficients returns one row per term; predict returns the input rows plus prediction and residual.

intercept.title: Fit intercept
intercept.description: When false the model is y = slope * x (no intercept term).

output.title: Prediction column
output.description: Name of the prediction column added by predict mode.
